description: List the app's private files (photos and PDFs the app stored), newest first: id, name, type, size, created. No links or contents; use read_file to see one.

app.description: The app's slug or id (from list_apps / create_app).

include_deleted.description: Also list files in the trash (they show deleted_at).

limit.description: How many files to return (default 50, max 100).

offset.description: How many files to skip (for the next page).

name: list_files
